notes.frame: Phosphor's map-pin (0.14 % of its ink uncovered at regular before the cut), with the bell-slash slash. The ring's centre lies 16 units on the upper-right side of the slash, so only its upper-right arc stays (stopping 32 units from the slash): the lower-left part would have been a D 16 units deep that fills in solid, so it is left out, as camera-slash leaves out the small part of its lens.
notes.request: Also answers homepage#406 (map pin with an x for a forbidden or invalid location); Phosphor answered there that a slashed map-pin is in its backlog.
